newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai sugar output reaches 2.85 mln T, yield low.
newsitem.headline: Thai sugar output reaches 2.85 mln T, yield low.

text.p: Thailand's sugar production reached 2.85 million tonnes as it entered the 13th week of the crushing season with yield still trailing behind that of the last season, an industry ministry source said on Wednesday.
As of February 10, sugar cane totalling 29.08 milliom tonnes were crushed by 46 mills across the country to produce 1.73 million tonnes of raw sugar and 1.12 million tonnes of white.
The yield was recorded at 98.17 kg of sugar per a tonne of sugar cane and the commercial cane sugar (CCS) of 11.20 percent.
"The yield picked up from around 96 kg/tonne last week but still lower than that of the corresponding period last year," the source said.
Molasses production amounted to 1.18 million tonnes.
The 1996/97 crushing season started late November and is expected to last until May or early June.
